description:
Get Tripadvisor Search Results

Runs a Tripadvisor search for a free-text query (a destination, a property name, or a listing-style phrase like "luxury hotels in new york city") with optional search origin coordinates, result type filter, Tripadvisor domain and offset-based pagination. Returns `places` (destinations, hotels, restaurants, attractions and tours with place ID, type, link, description, rating, review count, location, thumbnail and the review snippet that matched the query), `forums` for the forums type, `locations` for Tripadvisor list pages the query resolves to, and `pagination` with the next offset. Each place carries a `hasdataLink` that calls the Tripadvisor Place API for its full details; use it to enrich results, or to build travel and hospitality datasets for a destination.

domain.description: Tripadvisor domain to use. The domain sets the language of the results. Default is `www.tripadvisor.com`.

lat.description: Latitude of the search origin. Requires `lon`. Results near this point are ranked higher.

lon.description: Longitude of the search origin. Requires `lat`.

offset.description: Number of results to skip, e.g. `30` for the second page with the default limit. Use `pagination.nextOffset` from the previous response. Tripadvisor serves results up to offset 1000.

q.description: The search query, e.g. a destination, a property name or a phrase like `luxury hotels in new york city`.

type.description: Limits results to one type. `all` mixes destinations, hotels, restaurants and things to do; `forums` returns forum topics instead of places.
